title: Fezolinetant
overview: Fezolinetant may cause serious or life threatening liver damage. Tell your doctor if you have or ever have had cirrhosis (scarring and damage to your liver) or liver disease. Your doctor may tell you not to take fezolinetant. If you experience any of the following symptoms, stop taking fezolinetant and call your doctor immediately: extreme tiredness, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, itching, yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark yellow or brown-colored urine, pale stools, or pain in the upper right part of the stomach.

sections.Before taking fezolinetant,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to fezolinetant, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in fezolinetant tablets. Ask your pharmacist for a list of the ingredients.Some medications should not be taken with fezolinetant. Make sure you have discussed any medications you are currently taking or plan to take before starting fezolinetant with your doctor and pharmacist. Before starting, stopping, or changing any medications while taking fezolinetant, please get the advice of your doctor or pharmacist.tell your doctor if you have kidney disease. Your doctor may tell you not to take fezolinetant depending on the status of your condition.tell your doctor if you have any other medical conditions.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while taking fezolinetant, call your doctor.
